import pytest
from boltons.mathutils import clamp, ceil, floor, Bits
def test_clamp():
    assert clamp(-2, 0, 5) == 0
    assert clamp(9, 0, 5) == 5
    assert clamp(3, 0, 5) == 3
    with pytest.raises(ValueError): clamp(1, 5, 0)
def test_options():
    assert ceil(3, [5, 1, 3]) == 3
    assert floor(4, [5, 1, 3]) == 3
    with pytest.raises(ValueError): ceil(6, [1, 5])
    with pytest.raises(ValueError): floor(0, [1, 5])
def test_bits():
    bits = Bits('0011')
    assert bits.as_int() == 3
    assert bits.as_bin() == '0011'
    assert bits[3] is True
    assert bits[:2] == Bits('00')
    assert Bits.from_bytes(bits.as_bytes()).as_int() == 3
